g.text: Chronic Hepatitis D (HDV) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
two-substrate assembly line: host-made genome × HBV-made envelope · 18 clusters · 168 nodes
therapies placed on the flux they cut — entry (bulevirtide) · envelopment (lonafarnib, siRNA/NAP) · intracellular + infected-cell loss (IFN-α/λ)
